caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your phone feels gravity and motion just like you do? 🤯

💡 Every time your phone screen flips, tiny internal sensors (accelerometers and gyroscopes) detect subtle shifts, giving it a precise 'inner ear' for spatial awareness.
